description: This file manages workspace setup, file caching, template loading, and workspace directory initialization for the openclaw project. It includes functions for ensuring workspace structure, loading bootstrap files, and handling git repository initialization.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAgentWorkspaceDir
methods.description: Determines the default directory for agent workspace based on environment variables and OS home directory.

methods.name: loadWorkspaceBootstrapFiles
methods.description: Loads standard bootstrap files from the workspace directory, including optional memory files.

methods.name: filterBootstrapFilesForSession
methods.description: Filters bootstrap files based on session key, allowing minimal set for certain session types.

methods.name: loadExtraBootstrapFiles
methods.description: Loads additional bootstrap files matching provided glob patterns.

methods.name: loadExtraBootstrapFilesWithDiagnostics
methods.description: Loads extra bootstrap files with detailed diagnostics on load issues.

methods.name: isWorkspaceSetupCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the workspace setup process has been completed based on stored state.
